lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns with consistent spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical columns of the high-luminance blobs, creating a coordinate-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five to seven high-reflectance, elongated pixel groups (likely commensal organisms) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower silhouette.
